about: Story scenes of Volume 1, chapter 3, Moonshadow Bamboo Sea: the voided contract, Envoy Ku Ye, and Mo Yingyue joining (draft).

lines.text: South of the river lies the Moonshadow Bamboo Sea, a forest so tall and so endless that the moon seems to rise from somewhere inside it.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: The token at the ford, the pill box at Frostpeak, Old Qian's gossip. Everyone tells the same story: a Netherflame buyer who smiles and pays in black jade. And every rumour leads here.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Then we find him and ask him questions. With a sword.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Perhaps with words first?

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Words first. Then the sword.
An hour later, they pass the same broken bamboo stalk for the third time.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: The bamboo moves.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: The bamboo doesn't move. We're lost. I may have been holding the map upside down.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Tao Yao...
Something rustles high in the stalks. Many-legged shadows slide down toward the path, and somewhere in the dark, a fox laughs.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Good. Something I can cut.
Night in the bamboo. Su Lianhua banks the fire. Ling Shuang sits with her sword across her knees, eyes closed but not asleep.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: We are being watched. Since dusk.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Six. Seven. One of them I cannot hear at all. That one worries me.
The fire goes out. Shadows pour from the bamboo: black-robed shades and laughing fox warriors, blades already drawn.
In the confusion, a flicker of violet lightning. Cold steel rests against your throat, and someone breathes softly at your ear.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: ...That's not right.
The blade vanishes, and so does she. The other assassins do not hesitate.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Pavilion Master! Back to back, now!
When the last assassin falls, a girl in violet is sitting on a bamboo stalk high above the camp, swinging her feet and eating a candied hawthorn.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: You fight better than he said. He said a lot of things.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Come down here.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: No, thank you. You have a very unfriendly sword.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Mo Yingyue, of the Moonshadow Pavilion. I was paid to kill your Pavilion Master tonight. As you may have noticed, I didn't.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Because the client lied. He said my target was a Netherflame harvester who burned Peach Blossom Ford and steals girls with strange talents.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Then I watched your camp for three hours. The healer is from a temple. The swordswoman would cut off her own hand before she let anyone steal her. And the target gave half of supper to the steward.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Also, this was in your sleeve. I always take a sweet from my targets. Professional habit.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: That was my candied hawthorn.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: And now it's my fee for not killing you. Fair.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That is not fair at all!

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Moonshadow kills for coin, never for a lie. A contract with a lie in it is void. So: void. Congratulations, you're alive.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: And the client?

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Owes me the rest of my fee and an explanation. He's meeting me past the spider hollows to pay, once you're dead. I'd like to be there when he finds out you aren't.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: You may come along. For a reasonable price.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: We could pay you in lotus seed cakes.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: ...Are they sweet?

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Very.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Then we'll talk.
Where the bamboo thins into a misty glade, a woman in silver-trimmed silk reclines on a rock as if it were a throne. Behind her, a dozen foxes watch with very human eyes.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Travellers! How lovely. And how unfortunate. This is Fox Clan ground, and nothing crosses it for free.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Lady Hu Qiao. She smiles a great deal. Don't trust any of it.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Little Moonshadow, you wound me. I trust everyone exactly as much as they deserve. Which is not at all.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Your foxes attacked our camp last night.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Some of my children take Netherflame coin. Children are like that. It doesn't make them any less mine.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: The toll is simple. First, show me you are strong enough to be worth bargaining with. My children would like to play.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: And second?

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Second, a favour owed. I will name it once you have earned the right to hear it.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: I really don't like owing foxes favours.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: No one does, darling. That's what makes them so valuable.
The last fox warrior tumbles into the ferns, and the rest scatter, laughing. Lady Hu Qiao applauds lazily.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Strong enough. Barely. You may cross.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Now, the favour. One of my kits ran away a year ago. Silver fur, sharp tongue, sticky fingers. She has fallen in with bad company, and bad company is about to get her killed.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: If you meet her, and with that lotus of yours, you will, send her home alive. Whatever she has done.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Of course we will.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: "Of course we will" is a very poor negotiating position, healer.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Oh, I like your healer. Here, a little pouch for the road. I embroidered it myself.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: ...I'll hold on to it. For safekeeping.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: She means she's keeping it.

lines.speaker: npc:lady_hu_qiao
lines.text: Of course she is. Off you go. And do remember your debt to the Fox Clan.
The spider hollows are a sunken valley where the bamboo grows so thick it blots out the sky. Webs as wide as fishing nets hang between the stalks.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: The meeting place is on the far side. Step where I step. Don't touch the webs. Don't scream.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Why would anyone scream?

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Look up.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: AAAH!

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Like that. Don't do that.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: You know these hollows well, Mo Yingyue.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Moonshadow trains here. Nobody follows you into a valley full of spiders. Mostly.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Something is following us now.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Then it can meet the spiders. Or us. Your call, employer.

records.name: A Spirit Beast in a Snare

lines.text: Beyond the hollows lies a still pool ringed with moonlit bamboo. In its shallows, something flashes red and gold: a koi as long as a child is tall, thrashing in a net of grey fire.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: A spirit koi! Pavilion Master, look at that net. It's woven from netherflame.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Netherflame snares. They drain a spirit beast dry and sell what's left as pill ingredients. Good money.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Mo Yingyue.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: I said it was good money. I didn't say I liked it.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Hold still, fish.
Ling Shuang's blade parts the burning threads, and Su Lianhua's hands glow jade green over the koi's scorched scales. Slowly, the fish stops thrashing.
It circles the pool once, then twice, brushing each of you with a cool flick of its tail. Then it is gone. Where it lay in the shallows rests a single pearly egg.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: A koi's thanks! That's luck, you know. Real luck. Keep it warm, Pavilion Master.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: We don't get paid for fish.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Some things are their own payment.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: ...You're going to be exhausting, aren't you?
The meeting place was empty. Only a slip of paper waited, pinned to a bamboo stalk with a black jade needle. In neat calligraphy it said: "The Envoy regrets."

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: He knew I'd broken the contract. Then he knows where I'd go next.
When they reach Moonshadow Pavilion, a tower of black lacquer hidden among the tallest bamboo, it is already ringed with Netherflame agents.
On the highest roof, untroubled by the arrows flying past her, a woman in grey silk is pouring tea.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: Yingyue. You bring guests, and your guests bring trouble. These gentlemen on my walls are here to silence you, I assume.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: I've seen the client's face, Madam. He'd like me to forget it. Permanently.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: Then come up. You have a contract to answer for. Did you break your contract, or did the contract break itself?

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: The client lied about the target. A Netherflame harvester, he said. The target is a sect master who gives away supper and frees fish.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: A contract with a lie in it was never a contract. It is void. And a client who lies to Moonshadow is no longer a client. He is a mark.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: The Pavilion will remember him. He signed his name with a withered branch.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: I'm keeping the deposit.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: Of course you are. Now, since your guests are here, perhaps they could do something about the vermin on my walls.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Gladly.
The fleeing agents lead you to a clearing where the bamboo has been cut down in a perfect circle. In it stand a dozen figures of grey stone, all carved with the same smile.
One of them turns its head. The voice that comes out of it is warm, courteous, and delighted.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Mo Yingyue. Such a disappointment. I paid good black jade for a dead Pavilion Master, and instead you bring them to my door alive.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: You lied in my contract, Envoy.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Everyone lies in contracts, my dear. The trick is to sign them anyway.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: But where are my manners? Ku Ye, Envoy of the Netherflame Sect, humble servant of the Matriarch. I buy what is for sale, and I find that almost everything is.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: You bought Han Lie.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Cheaply, too. Sixty years of envy goes for very little.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: And you, Pavilion Master. Following threads, collecting seeds, and you have no idea what you are, do you? How restful that must be.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Don't you talk to them!

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Oh, the little steward has claws. Well. My puppets will see you out.
Past the broken puppets, in the shadow of a shattered stone shrine, Ku Ye waits in person: a slender man in black silk embroidered with withered branches, smiling as if greeting old friends.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: You broke my puppets. Those were expensive. I'll add them to your account.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Add this too.
A violet blade flashes across the clearing. Ku Ye steps aside from it as lazily as a man avoiding a puddle.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Temper, temper. Moonshadow should know better than to work for free.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: No one here is working for coin. We're here to stop you.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Everyone works for coin, little lotus. Some just haven't been offered the right one yet. Come, then. Let me show you what I charge.
Ku Ye staggers, his black silk torn, his smile crooked for the first time. Then he laughs.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Well struck. Truly. Let's call our contract renegotiated.

lines.speaker: npc:envoy_ku_ye
lines.text: Do visit the Matriarch's garden someday, Pavilion Master. You will, you know. Everyone does, in the end.
The ground beneath him softens into dry dust, and he sinks into it like a stone into water. By the time Ling Shuang's sword strikes the spot, there is only bare earth.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Fled. Into the ground, like a worm.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: He'll surface. Liars always do.
Mo Yingyue sheathes her daggers and looks at you for a long moment. At your belt, the Fate Lotus has grown warm. A violet thread runs from its heart to hers, crackling like distant thunder.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: ...So that's what that was. I felt it in the camp, with my blade at your throat. Something in me said: not this one.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Your Dao Seed knew before you did. They do that.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Hm. Well. I am currently unemployed, the Envoy is still breathing, and somebody has to make sure he stays a mark.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: So. A new contract, on Moonshadow terms. I guard you, I cut down whatever you point at, and I don't set foot in temples.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: And the payment?

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Candied hawthorns. One string a day. Two on days I save your life.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Deal.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: You were my target, you know. Now you're my employer. Pay well.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: She'll eat us out of the Pavilion.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Only the sweet parts.
High in the bamboo, a teacup clinks. Madam Yue has been watching all along.

lines.speaker: npc:madam_yue
lines.text: Moonshadow witnesses the contract. Keep this one, Yingyue.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: A contract is a contract, Madam. Until it isn't. But this one, I'll keep.
